name: peers
description: Scan other clanker instances, or deliver a machine notification. The action defaults to phonebook, which fetches every configured peer's agent card and reports up/down. {"action": "notify", "peer": "<name>", "message": "..."} writes a notification on that peer (state/notifications.jsonl via POST /api/notify); omit "peer" to broadcast. Conversational messages use chat_dm, not notify.
llm_description: Scan peers or send a machine notification. action: phonebook (default, agent cards, up/down) | notify{peer?,message} (omit peer to broadcast). notify is not a chat message; use chat_dm to talk to an instance.

id.description: Stable notification delivery ID. Reuse it when retrying the same logical notification. If omitted, the tool generates one and echoes it back in the response (even on failure) for you to reuse on retry.
